content.title: SCHEDULING, TRIGGERS & EXECUTION MODES
content.content:
- **Fixed-interval scheduling**: Cron-based expressions for time-driven pipeline execution. Dynamic schedules can be parameterised at runtime via API.

- **External event triggers**: Triggered Tasks expose pipeline executions as REST API endpoints — callable from any system (orchestrators, portals, other pipelines). File-arrival triggers monitor file systems and trigger pipelines automatically. Message queue consumers (Kafka, JMS, RabbitMQ, SQS) subscribe to topics and trigger pipelines on message arrival. Webhook receivers route inbound HTTP POST events to pipelines.

- **AMQP queues**.

- **Ultra Pipelines**: High-performance streaming execution mode for high-volume, low-latency data movement (bulk extract, CDC streaming, real-time event processing). Ultra Pipelines sustain billions of records per day at enterprise scale.
